;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**Four people are killed and over 30 injured in a [[car bomb]] attack at a funeral for a senior [[Libyan National Army]] commander in [[Benghazi]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/four-killed-as-car-bomb-targets-funeral-in-libyas-benghazi-sources-idUSKCN1U61QW?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A car bomb detonates in a Turkey-backed rebel city, [[Afrin, Syria|Afrin]], near the entrance, killing 11 and injuring over 30 badly. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-blast/blast-kills-11-wounds-many-in-syrias-rebel-held-afrin-idUSKCN1U610A (Reuters)]
**Another car bomb detonates in the city of [[Qamishli]] near a church, injuring 11. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] claimed responsibility. [https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/11072019 (Rudaw)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tropical Storm Barry (2019)]]
**[[Governor of Louisiana|Louisiana Governor]] [[John Bel Edwards]] declares a [[state of emergency]] as [[Tropical Storm Barry (2019)|Tropical Storm Barry]] makes unprecedented levels of [[rainfall]] on [[Louisiana]], [[Mississippi]], [[Alabama]] and the western [[Florida Panhandle]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/11/weather/tropical-flooding-thursday-wxc-trnd/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/gulf-of-mexico-storm-july-11-2019/index.html (CNN²)]
*Seven people, including six foreign tourists, are killed and 100 others injured during a violent storm that swept across [[Thessaloniki]], [[Greece]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48945821 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*British right-wing activist [[Tommy Robinson (activist)|Tommy Robinson]] is sentenced to nine months in prison for [[contempt of court]] — minus time served equals about another 10 weeks in prison. Supporters attacked police and journalists following the court proceedings. Police say no new arrests were made. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-48950672 (BBC News)]
*American R&B singer [[R. Kelly]] is arrested in [[Chicago]] on federal sex crime charges. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna1029126 (NBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[JAXA]]'s ''[[Hayabusa2]]'' space probe makes its second successful and final landing on [[Apollo asteroid]] [[162173 Ryugu]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/jul/11/falcon-has-landed-japans-hayabusa2-probe-touches-down-on-asteroid (''The Guardian'')]
